# Tracy client

Pinned official **v0.14.1**, https://github.com/wolfpld/tracy/tree/v0.14.1.
This directory contains the unmodified upstream `public/` client source and upstream BSD license.
Only `TracyClient.cpp` is compiled, and only when MSBuild `QvrTracy=true`.
Viewer/capture tools must match v0.14.1 and are not distributed in the repository.
Integration, build and capture instructions: `docs/vr-port/TRACY.md`.
